description: Burden of Trust auto picks must never come back blank. With NO unit teleported onto a marker (the normal turn-1 state the tutorial's 'Runnin' da Show' step walks through), the guard map used to be empty — every dropdown read '— No guard —' and 'Keep Auto Picks' assigned nothing at all. Now every objective is pre-filled with the closest friendly unit the player owns, so every GuardSelectionDialog picker shows a real unit and 'Keep Auto Picks' commits a full guard map.

steps.comment: the regression: with nobody standing on a marker the auto-assign used to produce {}
every auto-picked guard is a real unit the drawing player owns
index 0 is the '— No guard —' entry; every picker must land on a real unit
Keep Auto Picks now actually keeps something
